definition: The commitment is delivered as technical assistance, policy, regulation, standards, guidelines, strategies, studies, assessments or institutional capacity: it shapes how the asset is planned, procured or run, without paying for the asset itself.
The commitment is delivered by financing, constructing, installing, upgrading, procuring or deploying the asset or the physical and technical measure itself.

The commitment is delivered by operating, maintaining, monitoring, repairing or funding the upkeep of an asset that exists or is being built: maintenance contracts, spare parts, operating budgets, service-level agreements, training of operators.

The commitment is delivered by applying a digital asset to deliver a service or a response: using connectivity, data or a platform to reach people, run a programme or respond to an event, rather than building or governing the asset.
